mcq_fix.s: Which of the following were outcomes of the First Anglo-Sikh War (1846)? 1. Treaty of Bhairowal 2. Transfer of Kashmir to Gulab Singh under a separate Treaty of Amritsar 3. Annexation of Punjab Select the correct answer using the code given below.

mcq_drop.why: dubious: official ground for Awadh annexation was misgovernance, not 'primarily cotton market'

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Orientalists / Gita translation (Charles Wilkins)

patterns: Dominant shape: Governor-General <-> war/treaty matching (Hastings-Salbai, Minto-Amritsar, Hardinge-Lahore, Lord Hastings-Nepal/3rd Maratha).
Direct dates: Peshwaship abolished 1818, Sindh 1843 (Napier, Ellenborough), Sugauli 1815/16, Punjab 1849.
Chronology items (Wandiwash-Nand Kumar-Salbai-Tipu; GG order) recur; APPSC asked who defeated Tipu in 1799 (Wellesley).
Trap pairs: Warren Hastings vs Lord (Marquess) Hastings; Arthur Wellesley vs Lord Wellesley; Amritsar 1809 vs 1846.
App goes deeper (Bassein terms, Deogaon/Rajpurghat parties, battle commanders) than PYQs but mostly accurate.
